gen-dafont-origami-fs-bespoke-sans: Unique and a little bold, Origami draws its heading in one brush-like stroke, lowercase packed dense as poured lead. Bespoke Sans is the sharper, lighter foil.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab brings a classic, dignified text serif with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase. Origami above it keeps every stroke at constant width, brushed and contemporary.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-fauna-one: Dignified and literary, Fauna One sits low in its tall middle band, with ascenders and descenders kept shallow. Fauna One pairs with Origami's seamless joints; a modest size step between them should be plenty.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-glegoo: Brushy, blunt, unmistakably drawn: Origami builds uppercase from lines of one constant thickness, while Glegoo's tall lowercase has big counters. Origami makes the statement; Glegoo does the talking.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a traditional, refined text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s. And Origami above it draws everything like a plotter pen, one single-weight line.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noticia-text: Origami's lines hold the steady width of a technical drafting pen. It excels at striking, contemporary display, while Noticia Text, with its big entrances into curved letters and lowercase filling most of the height, handles the literary, dignified reading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, its high x-height squared off like woodblock letters and its c bent wide open. And Origami's rope-fine strokes keep the heading light against that weight.
gen-dafont-origami-inter: Origami's single-stroke brush look and dense lowercase mass make it the loud one here. But Inter is the better worker, with breathing counters and a smooth tube-like line.
gen-dafont-origami-roboto-slab: Precise meets playful: Origami's brushed single stroke leads, while Roboto Slab fills the line with a dominant middle zone. Origami's horizontals match its verticals, so the two feel built to share a page.
gen-dafont-origami-rubik: Rubik reads clean and soft, its lowercase looking big beside capitals and its round shapes staying clear when small. Rubik takes up Origami's pipe-like strokes and softens them into something friendly.
